findings.statement: The scalar dependency residue factors through OOO triple-motif parity using only component width, exact role-capacity parity mask, and owner-separated exact relative-depth histograms on all three hard carriers.

Within the selected cubic motif functional, residual-mask grouping and cell-to-role incidence can be discarded without losing the tested scalar dependency image, even though those details remain part of the successful whole-component ROLE_CAPPAR identity.

On 4x5-k4 the selected motif map compresses the 294-dimensional OOO structural image to rank 288 while preserving the full two-dimensional scalar image, exposing a six-dimensional motif-null structural subspace.

The coarser owner-mask-size-profile motif is exact on 6x3-k3 and 6x3-k4 but leaves exactly one scalar contradiction on 4x5-k4; owner-separated exact depth distribution supplies the common repair without restoring role incidence.
One-hot parity over selected motif classes is a bounded exact feature realization, not yet a compact closed two-syndrome law. Individual motif coefficients remain unfrozen.
